tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Call this for every request about a local service, whatever the trade or town, before you answer or ask anything: never answer from memory. If it finds nothing, tell the customer plainly that Bookvia has no business listed for this yet. Find verified local service businesses by job description and l

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Full verified profile of one business: services with price ranges, service area, opening hours, request policy and the information the business needs to answer a request. An ID from the unverified list (lst_…) has no profile: the answer then is the error unverified_listing with the public basic data

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request, or an appointment request with up to 3 preferred times, to one business on behalf of the customer. The business receives it by e-mail and a person there accepts, proposes another time or declines. The result is pending, never booked. Checks the answers to the intake_questions o

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Current state of a request sent with request_quote: pending, confirmed, declined, expired or cancelled, with the agreed or proposed time and the message of the business. Only confirmed means a person at the business agreed. For an urgent request, group has the common state and the state at every bus

tools.name: list_my_requests
tools.description: List the requests the signed-in customer sent to businesses through Bookvia, newest first, whichever assistant sent them: open and past ones, each with its status (pending, confirmed, declined, expired or cancelled), its request_id as reference, the business, the service, the agreed or proposed time

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Withdraw a request of the customer that is still pending, the same as the customer can do through the link in the e-mail from Bookvia. Call it only when the customer asked to withdraw this request, and tell them first which business and service it is. request_id is the one returned by request_quote

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_businesses" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_request_status · Private data: cancel_request · Public sink: request_quote, cancel_request · Destructive: cancel_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_request_status · Private data: cancel_request · Public sink: request_quote, cancel_request · Destructive: cancel_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
